mapper.select: SELECT cc.CURRICULUM_CODE, cc.CLASS_CODE, cc.CURRICULUM_TYPE AS STEP_NO, cc.CURRICULUM_TITLE AS TITLE, cc.CURRICULUM_CONTENT AS CONTENT, cc.CURRICULUM_IMG AS IMAGE_PATH FROM CLASS_CURRICULUM cc JOIN CLASS c ON c.CLASS_CODE = cc.CLASS_CODE WHERE cc.CLASS_CODE = #{classCode} AND c.OPERATOR_CODE = #{authorCode} ORDER BY cc.CURRICULUM_TYPE, cc.CURRICULUM_CODE
